_note: Every regulation, zone and rule points to one or more source ids here. 'in_project' = document is in the BlueCompliance project knowledge base and was read for this dataset.

sources.title: MEPC.1/Circ.778/Rev.4 – List of Special Areas, Emission Control Areas and Particularly Sensitive Sea Areas
sources.used_for: Designation status and effective dates of all Special Areas, ECAs and PSSAs; PSSA associated protective measures.

sources.title: MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022 (IMO IF520E) – scanned copy
sources.used_for: Annex I/IV/V/VI discharge and emission criteria in the rule set. NOTE: the copy in the project knowledge base is an empty file (784 bytes) – rule wording has not been verified against it; re-upload the consolidated text and verify.

sources.title: Resolution A.982(24) – Revised Guidelines for the Identification and Designation of PSSAs
sources.used_for: PSSA concept, associated protective measures framework.

sources.title: Resolution MEPC.356(78) – 2022 Guidelines for brief sampling of anti-fouling systems on ships
sources.used_for: AFS PSC sampling context; reference to cybutryne controls (MEPC.331(76)).

sources.title: Resolution MEPC.357(78) – 2022 Guidelines for inspection of anti-fouling systems on ships
Resolution MEPC.358(78) – 2022 Guidelines for survey and certification of anti-fouling systems on ships
Regulation (EU) 2023/957 amending Regulation (EU) 2015/757 (MRV) – inclusion of maritime transport in the EU ETS
sources.used_for: EU ETS maritime scope (voyage/port based, not position based).

sources.title: Natural Earth 1:50m ocean polygon
sources.used_for: Coastline used to clip regulatory boundary envelopes into sea-area polygons. Screening quality only; not a nautical chart.

sources.title: MEPC 83 outcomes (Canadian Arctic ECA, Norwegian Sea ECA) – NOT YET IN PROJECT SOURCES
sources.used_for: Placeholder entries only. Obtain MEPC.1/Circ.778/Rev.5 or the adopting resolutions before enabling.

sources.title: Resolution MEPC.190(60) – North American ECA (new Appendix VII)
sources.used_for: Machine-readable source of the 298 NA ECA coordinates (IMO website text layer), cross-checked against the 2022 edition.

sources.title: Resolution MEPC.202(62) – United States Caribbean Sea ECA
sources.used_for: Machine-readable source of the 55 US Caribbean ECA coordinates, cross-checked against the 2022 edition.

sources.title: Natural Earth 1:10m land polygons
sources.used_for: Coastline for the landward closure of every zone polygon and for the chart base layer.
